title: AzeoTech DAQFactory
overview: VULNERABILITY OVERVIEW INCORRECT DEFAULT PERMISSIONS CWE-276 Local, non-administrative users may be able to replace or modify original application files with malicious ones. CVE-2017-12699 has been assigned to this vulnerability. A CVSS v3 base score of 7.1 has been calculated; the CVSS vector string is ( AV:L/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:N ). UNCONTROLLED SEARCH PATH ELEMENT CWE-427 An uncontrolled search path element vulnerability has been identified, which may execute malicious DLL files that have been placed within the search path. CVE-2017-5147 has been assigned to this vulnerability. A CVSS v3 base score of 4.2 has been calculated; the CVSS vector string is ( AV:L/AC:H/PR:L/UI:R/S:U/C:L/I:L/A:L ). RESEARCHER Karn Ganeshen reported these vulnerabilities to ICS-CERT. BACKGROUND Critical Infrastructure Sectors: Critical manufacturing, Energy, and Water Countries/Areas Deployed: United States and Europe Company Headquarters Location: United States This product is provided subject to this  Notification  and this  Privacy & Use  policy.
